articles.title: Serbia wakes up to new reality after student-led movement ousts Vučić – Europe live
articles.summary:
Hopes raised for a reset in relations with EU and other partners following the defeat of authoritarian president

  • Serbian leader ousted by student movement in seismic election

More European leaders have now logged in after the weekend and are sending their congratulations to Serbia’s Student List after their win over Vučić last night.

Ukraine’s president Volodymyr Zelenskyy said:

“There have been changes in Serbia – a victory of the Student List @studentblokade. And this is clearly a new chapter in the history of the country and its people. We wish Serbia success, real development, and warm relations with the European community.

We in Ukraine thank Serbia for respecting our people, our state, and our independence. And we always celebrate our shared achievements – everything that strengthens our societies and gives people more opportunities. We are ready to continue expanding our cooperation, and may all the good hopes of the people of Serbia come true!”

“The parliamentary elections in Serbia are clearly decided. We congratulate the Student List! With its demands for the rule of law, the fight against corruption, and fundamental freedoms, it has reached the people. We will actively support Serbia’s European path.”

“Congratulations to the Student List on its decisive victory and to the people of Serbia that turned out in record numbers to choose their future. This is an opportunity to strengthen democracy, the rule of law, and the fight against corruption. Sweden continues to support reforms that underpin Serbia’s EU accession.”

“The people of Serbia have made their voices heard. Congratulations to the Student List @studentblokade on its electoral victory.

Their calls for democracy, the rule of law and the fight against corruption reflect the importance of building trust in democratic institutions.

“The defeat of press freedom predator Aleksandar Vucic by the opposition movement Student List in the Sunday parliamentary election offers a historic opportunity to restore media freedom. RSF hails the courageous work of all journalists who resisted Vucic’s oppression for more than a decade.”

archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající volatilitu na trzích vlivem neustávajících protestů v západní Evropě a bezpečnostních obav spojených s vývojem na Ukrajině.
archive.forecast_en: Persistent market volatility is expected over the coming days driven by ongoing protests in Western Europe and security concerns linked to developments in Ukraine.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vlně masivních protivládních protestů a sociálních nepokojů, zejména ve Francii a Itálii, kde probíhají rozsáhlé demonstrace a střety s policií kvůli životním nákladům. Současně přetrvávají vážná bezpečnostní rizika spojená s válkou na Ukrajině, kde pokračují útoky na Krym a logistická napojení na frontu včetně nedávných výkyvů v síti Starlink.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of massive anti-government protests and social unrest, particularly in France and Italy, where widespread demonstrations and clashes with police over the cost of living are taking place. At the same time, severe security risks persist regarding the war in Ukraine, with ongoing strikes on Crimea and front-line logistical dependencies, including recent fluctuations in the Starlink network.
archive.forecast_cs: V příštích dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající napětí na finančních trzích v důsledku probíhajících demonstrací v klíčových evropských zemích a přetrvávajících bezpečnostních rizik na Ukrajině.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent tension on financial markets is expected due to ongoing demonstrations in key European countries and lingering security risks in Ukraine.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci eskalujících geopolitických napětí, včetně prudkého nárůstu cen zemního plynu kvůli obavám z Blízkého východu, a masivních vnitřních nepokojů ve Francii. Pozitivním impulzem je neočekávaná demokratická změna moci v Srbsku po prohře dlouholetého prezidenta Vučiće, což otevírá cestu k reformám.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces a combination of escalating geopolitical tensions, including soaring natural gas prices over Middle East supply fears, and massive domestic protests in France. A positive counterweight is the unexpected democratic transition in Serbia following long-serving President Vučić's defeat, paving the way for reform.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na energetických trzích a napjatou bezpečnostní situaci kvůli protivládním protestům ve Francii. Pozornost se bude soustředit na přípravu rozpočtů a geopolitická jednání.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued volatility in energy markets and tense security conditions due to anti-government protests in France are expected. Focus will remain on upcoming national budgets and geopolitical talks.
